connections.why: Talking about family and friends extends naturally into health, food and daily routines
Relationships are increasingly conducted through social media and shared online culture
Food, sport and wellbeing recur when describing holidays and life in German-speaking countries
Digital skills and online media shape modern study and future career opportunities
Future plans often involve work, study or travel abroad in German-speaking regions
Places, transport and the natural world locally mirror the language needed for tourism
Shops, amenities and the local environment shape everyday lifestyle choices
The prescribed vocabulary list supplies the core words for every thematic context
Vocabulary and grammar are combined to build accurate spoken and written German
Sound-symbol correspondences in the grammar appendix are tested directly by the dictation task
Accurate pronunciation in the read-aloud task relies on the prescribed SSCs
Reading comprehension and translation sample vocabulary from across the prescribed list
Open-response writing and translation draw on the full prescribed vocabulary
Personal-world topics are staple thematic contexts for read-aloud and conversation cards
Listening texts such as podcasts and clips draw on media and technology contexts
Travel and tourism is a frequent context for reading passages and translation
Study and future-plans contexts prompt formal and informal extended writing
Translation into English and into German are mirror skills built on the same texts and structures
Understanding spoken German underpins responding fluently in the speaking conversation
